messages:
maria: Quick check — iterating on the batch vectors preview and rerank UX. New Figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/DEF456 (frame: 'Batch Vectors: Preview + Rerank v1'). Needs: export placement, keyboard nav, tooltip copy, and how we show rerank progress for large batches. Thoughts? @ryan @jamal

ryan: Saw the frame. Two layout notes: 1) The export control currently lives inside the header row; on narrow viewports it pushes the column labels down. I'd prefer a dedicated toolbar above the table that can collapse into a kebab menu for mobile. 2) We should pin the toolbar on scroll so actions stay visible while scanning results.

alex: Agree on toolbar. From infra side, if we pin it we need to ensure it doesn't cover the table header cells when table is scrolled into view. Sticky toolbar with a fixed offset works. Also watch out for virtualization - sticky inside a virtual list needs special handling.

jamal: Accessibility: focus order is the highest priority. Export must be reachable before interactive preview cards. Current tab sequence puts cards first. Also badges indicating relevance rely on color; add text labels (e.g., "High relevance") and ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for small text.

olivia: Product requirements: CSV export should include: batch_id, item_index, original_text, vector_id, similarity_score, rerank_rank. Include a short footer in the export modal explaining rerank_rank is 1-based, 1 == highest similarity. Also we should record export events for telemetry (user_id, batch_id, exported_at).

sam: A UX question: for very large batches (>5k rows) we shouldn't try to rerank inline synchronously. Proposal: show sampled preview of top 50 results and run full rerank as background job with a notification when ready. That keeps the initial feedback fast.

maria: That matches what I was thinking. Microcopy: change button label from "Export" to "Export results (CSV)"; change rerank CTA to "Rerank by similarity". Tooltip for similarity score: "Cosine similarity between query and vector (0-1)".

design-bot: Accessibility scan: missing ARIA on export menu items and no announce when background rerank completes. Recommend aria-haspopup, aria-expanded on menu toggle and `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` for completion messages.

jamal: Suggest SR announcement example: "Background rerank started for batch 1234. A notification will appear when complete." And when finished: "Rerank complete: results updated. Top score 0.92." Use polite live region.

ryan: Implementation notes: keyboard shortcut idea — press 'E' to open export modal, shift+R to trigger rerank. Sample keybinding snippet:
```
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'e' && !e.metaKey && !e.ctrlKey) openExportModal();
  if (e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') triggerRerank();
});
```
We need to ensure these don't collide with OS/browser shortcuts.

alex: For the sticky toolbar: use position: sticky; top: var(--nav-height); and set pointer-events properly. For virtualized lists, put the toolbar outside the scroller and synchronize width. I'll add unit tests for the header collision case.

maria: Decisions to capture: 1) Move export into an above-table toolbar, left-aligned, label "Export results (CSV)". 2) Toolbar collapses to kebab on <720px. 3) Keyboard shortcuts: 'E' for export, 'Shift+R' for rerank; include shortcut hint in the tooltip. 4) For batches >5k, show sampled preview (top 50) and run background job with notification; otherwise inline rerank (<=500ms). 5) CSV fields per product note. 6) Add text labels for relevance badges and improve contrast token. 7) aria-live polite region for rerank status and ARIA on menu items.

jamal: I'll draft a short accessibility guidance doc with focus order, sample live-region text, and badge alternatives.

olivia: I'll create an acceptance criteria ticket covering telemetry, CSV schema, and background rerank behavior.

ryan: I'll prototype the sticky toolbar + kebab collapse and wire the keyboard shortcuts in a branch. Will add focus management to ensure export is first tabbable item.

sam: I'll update the sampling logic for previews and add a flag to enable background rerank jobs with notification hooks.

alex: I'll ship the header overlap hotfix and coordinate on virtual list edge cases.

design-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: + focus order doc, + aria-live, + menu aria attributes.

maria: Thanks all — please paste PR links and the prototype here when available. Closing this thread until we have a prototype review. :rocket:
